look_here_first: Inspect the annual slender taproot, then compare lower spreading or deflexed stem hairs with straighter appressed hairs above.

morphology_keys.stem_hairs: Lower spreading or deflexed; upper strigose
morphology_keys.head: About 44 to 70 rays, 3 to 6 mm long; involucre 2.5 to 3.5 mm high

comparisons.key_distinctions: E. modestus often has woody persistent root crown; E. tenellus has strongly clasping leaves. Former geiseri var. calcicola belongs to E. versicolor.
